synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours: horizontal mirror axis (ring 10), pieces (ring 5), solid targets (11).
Selection = axis (0 dots) or a piece (0 centres, grown through non-9 centres); A1/A2 move one block row, A3/A4 one block col (axis only moves by row); pieces are blocked by the board edge and by other pieces.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size descending -> axis. Reflections (solid 4) go to row 2A-r, skipping on-axis sources, off-board cells and cells under a piece.
HUD col 63: n effective actions -> 12s from the top (5s past 64). Stateless, so no hidden state is needed.
Not confirmed: tie order among equal-size pieces in the A5 cycle.
